chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ubayd ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:
Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'Wear rings with Yemeni onyx, for it repels the plots of the rebellious devils.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, a title for Imam Ali (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الْجَزْعِ الْيَمَانِيِّ: Yemeni onyx, a specific type of stone used for rings
key_terms.مَرَدَةِ الشَّيَاطِينِ: Rebellious/devilish devils, referring to those who strongly oppose divine guidance

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of wearing Yemeni onyx according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi emphasizes the spiritual efficacy of the Yemeni onyx (al-jaz' al-yamani), a material highly prized in Islamic tradition for its purity and connection to the Prophet's lineage. By recommending this specific stone to repel the 'rebellious devils' (maradat al-shayatin), the Imam underscores the Shia belief in the tangible spiritual benefits of blessed objects (al-ashya' al-mubarakah) as a means of protection and divine favor.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Ubeyd Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn Bin Ali Bin Al Husayn, from his father, from his grandfather who said,
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You should be wearing rings with the Yemeni onyx for it repels the plots of the Accursed satans<sup>la</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Ubayd ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn from his father from his grandfather has said the following: “’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Use Yemenite carnelian as the ring; it dispels plots, the evil plans of defiant Satans.’”
